Hi there!

The story behind Spiffy

I started making wreaths because I love decorating for every holiday, and pretty soon friends and family were asking for their own. That turned into Spiffy Wreaths.

Every one starts as a plain frame and a pile of mesh and ribbon, and I build it up by hand from there, skulls, snowmen, glitter spiders and all. You can also find me at local craft fairs with my resin keychains and little gifts.

  • Every wreath made by hand, start to finish
  • Every piece is one of a kind
  • Custom colors, themes and sizes
  • Wreaths for every holiday and season
  • Local pickup or grab one at an event
  • Cash, Cash App and PayPal accepted

xo, Spiffy Wreaths

custom orders

No two are ever the same

Custom is what I do best. Every order gets designed and built from scratch around what you want, so yours will be the only one like it. Here's how it works.

1.

Tell me the idea

Send the theme, colors and size you want. A photo of your door or something you like helps a lot.

2.

I design it

We'll go over the details and price together, then I get to work building it by hand.

3.

It's all yours

Pick it up locally or at my next event. A one of a kind wreath nobody else has.

FAQ

Questions I get a lot

Can you make a wreath in my colors or for my team?

Yes! Custom orders are my favorite. Send me the colors, theme and size and I'll let you know what I can do.

How long does a custom wreath take?

It depends on the design and how busy the season is. Message me with the date you need it and I'll tell you if I can make it happen. Around the holidays, the earlier the better.

How much do wreaths cost?

Price depends on the size and how detailed it is. Send me what you have in mind and I'll give you a price before I start.

How do I get my wreath?

Local pickup, or grab it at one of my craft fair events. Just let me know what works best for you.

What forms of payment do you take?

Cash, Cash App and PayPal.

Can I buy one of the wreaths in the gallery?

Some may already be sold, but I can always make one in the same style. Tap the wreath and hit "Order this style."
